t: How the Dynamic Tag Generator works (Signature)
title: How the Dynamic Tag Generator works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Dynamic Tag Generator does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature method builds a tag ledger per record: each tag lists its extraction method, its source spans, and its confidence score, with the threshold frozen per run for reproducibility. The controlled vocabulary is versioned, so re-tagging years later maps to the same canonical forms. Curator-approved tags and machine tags live in separate ledger lanes, and the machine lane is never allowed to overwrite a human tag. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
